title: The Duck Council
description: Describe a situation and what you're about to do, and a council of opinionated AI ducks judges it. Each duck has its own worldview and a blind spot, so they genuinely disagree: every verdict stamps onto a quest board as it streams in, with a final score from 0 to 100. A local FastAPI app that works with Claude Code, the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, or offline models through Ollama.
